title: Edit distance exponents for irrational rotations
summary: We study quantitative edit-distance asymptotics for symbolic codings of irrational rotations $x \mapsto x+α$ on $\mathbb{T}$ in terms of the irrationality exponent $μ(α)$. For the binary coding determined by an interval $[0,β)$, let $d_N(x,y)$ be the edit distance between the codings of the orbits of the points $x$ and $y$ up to time $N-1$.
